ValidationRule.description: PD-5379, require loan number to be populated before an opportunity stage can be changed to Funded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Record_Type_Name__c <> 'Lease Oppty', ISBLANK(Merchant_Number__c), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Funded'), OR( CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding'), CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'Quick Bridge'), Lender_Account__r.Name = 'MLP' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An opportunity with lender of NF or QB cannot be in 'Funded' stage without a Merchant Number.
